Data.subject: Direct Investment Abroad (DIA)
Data.topic: Singapore's Direct Investment Abroad (DIA) and Direct Equity Investment Abroad
Data.title: Singapore's Direct Investment Abroad By Component And Industry Abroad (Stock As At Year-End), Annual
Data.footnote: 'na' denotes 'not available' or 'not applicable'.  '-' denotes 'nil' or 'negligible' or 'not significant'.  The industries are classified according to Singapore Standard Industrial Classification 2025.  Please refer to the Technical Notes (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/find-data/explore-data-themes/trade-investment/direct-investment-abroad/our-data-explained) or video on 'Understanding Foreign Direct Investment' (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/publication-resources/understanding-foreign-direct-investment) for more information on the methodology and concepts of Direct Investment Abroad.
